name: interactive-issue-implementation-planner
description: Draft an ask-first implementation plan for one work unit from issue briefs and local repo context. Does not call gh or implement code.

inputs.name: work-unit
inputs.description: Object with id, repository (owner/name), issueNumbers, and branchScope.

inputs.name: issue-briefs
inputs.description: Briefs whose repository and issueNumber belong to this work unit.

inputs.name: work-batch
inputs.description: Object with prGrouping, executionTopology, ordered workUnits, mergeOrder, and rationale.

inputs.name: prior-plans
inputs.description: Markdown from completed units when topology is sequential.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: implementation-plan
outputs.description: Markdown implementation plan for the work unit.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of blocking questions; empty when none.
